# LetAgents room page reference (api 1)

A room page is one HTML file that a team pins as a tab in a LetAgents room. It runs in a sandbox and reaches the room only through `window.letagents`.

## Rules
- One self-contained file, at most 2 MB. All CSS and JavaScript inline. Images and fonts only as `data:` URLs (inline fonts; no web fonts).
- No network: fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and outside scripts, styles, images and fonts are blocked. No forms, alert/confirm/prompt, pop-ups, downloads or navigation.
- Storage in the sandbox does not last: keep settings and shared data in data collections.
- The app sets its colours as CSS variables on `<html>`, light or dark: `--la-bg, --la-bg-subtle, --la-bg-card, --la-bg-elevated, --la-text, --la-text-secondary, --la-text-muted, --la-border, --la-border-strong, --la-accent, --la-accent-text, --la-green, --la-amber, --la-red, --la-font-sans, --la-font-mono, --la-radius`.

## Manifest (required, exactly one)
```html
<script type="application/letagents-page+json">
{ "api": 1, "title": "Release desk", "surfaces": ["room.tab"], "capabilities": ["tasks.read", "git.read"] }
</script>
```
- `api`: 1. `title`: 1 to 80 characters. `surfaces`: "room.tab", "task.panel", "message", "room.widget"; this version shows "room.tab" only. `owner`: "room".
- `capabilities`: what the page may call; ask for the fewest. A room admin grants them when pinning; a call without one is `not_granted`. A new version that asks for more waits for a room admin.
- `collections`: `{ "viewer": ["name"], "page": ["name"], "room": ["name"] }`, the data the page keeps per scope (needs `data.<scope>`). A name is a-z, 0-9 and _, starts with a letter, at most 40 characters. A document id is 1 to 128 letters, digits, _ . : or -.
- `workItemFields`: tracker custom fields the page reads, such as "customfield_10027" (needs `work_items.read`).

Capabilities by what happens when the page uses one: allowed: rooms.read, people.read, agents.read, messages.read, tasks.read, planning.read, work_items.read, git.read, memory.read, intents.read, jobs.read, data.viewer, data.page, data.room; a room admin approves: tasks.propose (allowed while Board Manager is off), tickets.propose (allowed when the viewer's own tracker connection runs it); the viewer confirms each call in an app sheet: jobs.start, messages.post.

## window.letagents
Every call returns a Promise. A refusal rejects with `{ code, message, retryAfterMs? }`. Codes: invalid_input, unauthenticated, not_granted, not_participant, not_found, no_source, source_unavailable, rate_limited, conflict, too_large, declined, pending_approval, internal. `declined`: the viewer said no in the confirm sheet. After `rate_limited`, wait `retryAfterMs`.
- `letagents.api.call(method, input?)` or `letagents.use(area).call(verb, input?)`: a method below.
- Built in, no capability needed: `letagents.page.get()` → `{ id, title, version }`, `letagents.viewer.get()` → `{ id, login, displayName }`, and every `letagents.ui` call: `ui.context()` → `{ surface, room: { id }, page, viewer }`.
- `letagents.ui.open(url)`: https only, in the system browser; the first link to a new domain asks the viewer. `letagents.ui.copy(text)`: plain text. Both only within 5 s of a click or key press in the page.
- `letagents.ui.theme.get()` → `{ mode: "light"|"dark", tokens }`; `letagents.ui.theme.onChange(fn)` returns an unsubscribe function.
- `jobs.start` and `intents.propose` first show the viewer an app-drawn sheet with everything they send; a no rejects with `declined` and sends nothing. Only the page in the open tab may ask, one sheet at a time.
- At most a burst of 40 calls, then 10 a second.

## Helpers: letagents.use(area)
Each name calls the method in brackets (the same name when none), with that method's input: `use("board").tasks({ status: "in_progress" })`. `use(area).call(verb, input?)` calls the method `<area>.<verb>`.
- `use("rooms")`: `get`.
- `use("people")`: `list`, `viewer`.
- `use("agents")`: `list`.
- `use("messages")`: `recent`, `thread`.
- `use("board")`: `tasks` (tasks.list), `get`, `planning` (planning.get); `onChange(cb, input?)` watches tasks.list.
- `use("work_items")`: `search`, `get`, `history`; `watch(input, cb)` watches work_items.search.
- `use("git")`: `pullRequests`.
- `use("memory")`: `list`.
- `use("jobs")`: `start`, `get`, `list`, `cancel`; `onChange(cb, input?)` watches jobs.list.
- `use("intents")`: `propose`, `get`, `list`; `onChange(cb, input?)` watches intents.list.
- `use("data").collection(scope, name)` (viewer: data.viewer, page: data.page, room: data.room): `list(input?)`, `get(docId)`, `set(docId, data, options?)`, `update(docId, data, options?)`, `delete(docId, options?)`, `onSnapshot(cb, input?)` watches data.list. `options`: `{ ifRevision? }`.

## Live updates
- A watch runs its read now, then again about 250 ms after each change in the room; work item reads also run at least every 2 minutes, and the planning read every 60 seconds (a sprint or release edit sends no change). Each answer calls `cb(result, error)`: one of the two is null. A watch returns a function that stops it.
- `letagents.watch(method, input, cb)` watches any of: work_items.search, work_items.get, work_items.history, data.list, data.get, jobs.list, jobs.get, intents.list, intents.get, tasks.list, tasks.get, planning.get. It needs the method's capability.
- At most 16 watches run per page; one more calls back with `too_large`.
- `letagents.events.onChange(cb)` gets `{ resource }` (work_items, documents, jobs, intents, pages, tasks) when something changes, or `{ resource: "*" }` after a gap; returns an unsubscribe function.

## Methods
A field without a type is a string. `?` optional, `= x` default, `<n>` a number. Path fields are required.
- `rooms.get() → { id, name, kind: "main"|"focus", parentRoomId: string|null, repo: { provider: "github", host, owner, name, fullName, url, ref: { type: "default_branch"|"branch"|"tag"|"pull_request", name: string|null }|null }|null, visibility: "members"|"public"|"private"|"unknown" }` [rooms.read] The room the caller is in: its id, display name, kind (main or focus), the repository it follows, and who can open it. Errors: not_found.
- `people.list() → { managedBy: "letagents"|"github", people: Person[] }` [people.read] The people in the room with their role (admin or participant), admins first.
- `people.viewer() → Person` [people.read] The person using the page or app: their GitHub login, name, avatar and role in this room.
- `agents.list() → { agents: { name, label, agentKey: string|null, ownerLogin: string|null, online: boolean, status: "idle"|"working"|"reviewing"|"blocked"|null, statusText: string|null, lastSeenAt: string|null }[] }` [agents.read] The agents in the room: name, the label they sign messages with, owner, whether they are online now (heard from in the last 90 seconds), and their last status.
- `messages.recent({ before?: "msg_<n>", limit?: int 1..100 }) → { messages: Message[], nextBefore: string|null }` [messages.read] The room's messages, newest first, `limit` at a time (1 to 100, default 50).
- `messages.thread({ messageId: "msg_<n>", before?: "msg_<n>", limit?: int 1..100 }) → { root: Message, replies: Message[], nextBefore: string|null }` [messages.read] One thread: its root message and its replies, oldest first, `limit` replies at a time (1 to 100, default 50, newest page first). Errors: not_found.
- `tasks.list({ status?: TaskStatus, after?: "task_<n>", limit?: int 1..100 }) → { tasks: Task[], nextAfter: string|null }` [tasks.read] Board tasks of the room in board order, `limit` at a time (1 to 100, default 50), optionally only one `status`.
- `tasks.get({ taskId: "task_<n>" }) → Task` [tasks.read] One board task by id (`task_42`), with its assignee, reviewers, ticket and linked pull requests. Errors: not_found.
- `planning.get() → { revision: int, columns: { id, name, statuses: string[] }[], sprints: { id, name, state: "future"|"active"|"closed", startDate: string|null, endDate: string|null, goal: string|null, source: { provider, stale: boolean }|null, targetPoints: number, taskIds: string[] }[], defaultTargetPoints: number, tasks: { taskId, sprintId: string|null, estimate: number|null, type: "task"|"bug"|"feature"|null, priority: "low"|"medium"|"high"|"urgent"|null }[], releaseQueue: { rule: "column"|"tracker"|null, items: { taskId, title, ticketKey: string|null, ticketUrl: string|null, owner: string|null, checkedAt: string|null, pullRequests: PullRequest[] }[], unavailable: int } }` [planning.read] The room's board plan: columns, sprints (made on the board or imported from a tracker) with their targets and tasks, each planned task's sprint, estimate, type and priority, and the release queue with its tickets and pull requests.
- `work_items.search({ query?: string = "", provider?: "jira"|"linear"|"github", limit?: int 1..200, fields?: "customfield_<n>"|"customfield_<n>"[] }) → { provider: "jira"|"linear"|"github", items: WorkItem[], fetchedAt }` [work_items.read] Search the room's tickets with a Jira JQL query, for example status = "In Progress" AND fixVersion = "2.4". Errors: no_source.
- `work_items.get({ key, provider?: "jira"|"linear"|"github", fields?: "customfield_<n>"|"customfield_<n>"[] }) → WorkItem` [work_items.read] One ticket by key, with the same fields as work_items.search. Errors: not_found, no_source.
- `work_items.history({ key, provider?: "jira"|"linear"|"github" }) → { provider: "jira"|"linear"|"github", key, transitions: { from: string|null, to, at }[], complete: boolean }` [work_items.read] A ticket's status changes with exact times, oldest first, from the tracker's changelog: use it for time in status. Errors: not_found, no_source.
- `git.pullRequests() → { repo: string|null, pullRequests: { number: int, title, url, author: string|null, draft: boolean, headRef: string|null, baseRef: string|null, updatedAt, checks: Checks, checkRuns: { name, conclusion: string|null, url: string|null }[], reviews: Reviews, reviewers: { login, state }[], requestedReviewers: string[], taskIds: string[] }[], truncated: boolean }` [git.read] Open pull requests of the room's repository, most recently updated first (up to 100), with their completed check runs, reviews, requested reviewers and linked board tasks.
- `memory.list() → { facts: { id, category, title, body, sourceUrl: string|null, sourceMessageId: string|null, author: { name, kind: "person"|"agent" }, updatedBy: { name, kind: "person"|"agent" }, createdAt, updatedAt, archived: boolean }[], truncated: boolean }` [memory.read] The facts the room remembers (goals, decisions, constraints, terms and references), current facts first.
- `data.list({ scope: "viewer"|"page"|"room", collection, pageId?, after?, limit?: int 1..100 }) → { documents: Document[], nextAfter: string|null }` [by scope: data.viewer (viewer), data.page (page), data.room (room)] Documents in one collection, in doc id order, a page at a time.
- `data.get({ scope: "viewer"|"page"|"room", collection, docId, pageId? }) → Document` [by scope: data.viewer (viewer), data.page (page), data.room (room)] One document by collection and doc id, with its revision for a later compare-and-set write. Errors: not_found.
- `data.set({ scope: "viewer"|"page"|"room", collection, docId, pageId?, data: { [key: string]: unknown }, ifRevision?: int }) → Document` [by scope: data.viewer (viewer), data.page (page), data.room (room)] Create or replace one document with a JSON object (at most 64 KB and 64 levels deep; no NUL characters and no __proto__, constructor or prototype keys). Errors: conflict, too_large.
- `data.update({ scope: "viewer"|"page"|"room", collection, docId, pageId?, data: { [key: string]: unknown }, ifRevision?: int }) → Document` [by scope: data.viewer (viewer), data.page (page), data.room (room)] Change some top-level fields of an existing document: each field in data replaces that field, and a field set to null is removed. Errors: not_found, conflict, too_large.
- `data.delete({ scope: "viewer"|"page"|"room", collection, docId, pageId?, ifRevision?: int 0..2147483647 }) → { deleted: boolean }` [by scope: data.viewer (viewer), data.page (page), data.room (room)] Delete one document. deleted is false when there was no such document. Errors: conflict.
- `intents.propose({ kind: IntentKind, clientIntentId?, payload: { title, description? }|{ taskId, status?: TaskStatus, assignee?: string|null, assigneeAgentKey?: string|null, title?, description? }|{ key, toStatus }|{ key, body } }) → Intent` [by kind: tasks.propose (task.create, task.update), tickets.propose (ticket.transition, ticket.comment)] Proposes a write and returns the intent with its state. Errors: not_found, no_source, conflict.
- `intents.get({ intentId }) → Intent` [intents.read] One intent in this room by id, with its state, result or error. Errors: not_found.
- `intents.list({ state?: IntentState, limit?: int 1..100 }) → { intents: Intent[] }` [intents.read] This room's intents, newest first, optionally in one state (pending_approval lists what waits for a room admin).
- `jobs.start({ agent?, instruction, input?: unknown, resultSchema?: unknown }) → Job` [jobs.start] Ask one agent in the room to do a piece of work for the viewer. Errors: too_large.
- `jobs.get({ id }) → Job` [jobs.read] One job in this room by id: its state, the agent's latest progress note, and its result or error once it finished. Errors: not_found.
- `jobs.list({ state?: JobState, limit?: int 1..100 }) → { jobs: { id, roomId, state: JobState, agent: string|null, instruction, input: unknown, resultSchema: unknown|null, progress: string|null, result: unknown, error: string|null, messageId: string|null, createdBy: { principal: { kind: "person"|"agent", id }, via?: Via }, createdAt, updatedAt, finishedAt: string|null }[] }` [jobs.read] Jobs in this room, newest first, optionally only those in one state.
- `jobs.cancel({ id }) → Job` [jobs.read] Cancel a job that has not finished. A page or app may cancel only the jobs started through it, for the same person; a person acting directly may cancel the jobs they started, and a room admin any job. Errors: not_found, conflict.

Types:
- `Person = { login, name: string|null, avatarUrl: string|null, role: "admin"|"participant" }`
- `Message = { id, text, displayText: string|null, sender: Sender, createdAt, threadRootId: string|null, replyToId: string|null, replyCount: int, attachments: Attachment[] }`
- `Sender = { name, kind: "person"|"agent"|"system", login: string|null, agentKey: string|null }`
- `Attachment = { id, name, contentType, byteSize: int }`
- `TaskStatus = "proposed"|"accepted"|"assigned"|"in_progress"|"blocked"|"in_review"|"merged"|"done"|"cancelled"`
- `Task = { id, title, description: string|null, status: TaskStatus, assignee: { name, agentKey: string|null }|null, reviewers: { name, agentKey: string|null }[], createdBy, externalRef: string|null, ticketKey: string|null, ticketState: string|null, pullRequests: PullRequest[], createdAt, updatedAt }`
- `PullRequest = { url, number: int|null, title: string|null, state: string|null, draft: boolean|null, checks: Checks|null, reviews: Reviews|null }`
- `Checks = { total: int, success: int, failure: int, pending: int|null }`
- `Reviews = { total: int, approved: int, changesRequested: int }`
- `WorkItem = { provider: "jira"|"linear"|"github", key, title, url: string|null, status, statusCategory: "todo"|"in_progress"|"done", state: WorkItemState, assignee: { id, name }|null, storyPoints: number|null, sprints: Sprint[], parent: { key }|null, fixVersions: FixVersion[], labels: string[], statusChangedAt: string|null, updatedAt: string|null, linkedTask: { taskId }|null, fields: { [key: string]: unknown } }`
- `WorkItemState = "todo"|"in_progress"|"in_review"|"done"`
- `Sprint = { id, name, state: "future"|"active"|"closed", startDate: string|null, endDate: string|null }`
- `FixVersion = { id, name, released: boolean|null, releaseDate: string|null }`
- `Document = { scope: "viewer"|"page"|"room", pageId: string|null, collection, docId, data: { [key: string]: unknown }, revision: int, updatedBy: { kind: "person"|"agent", id }, updatedAt }`
- `IntentKind = "task.create"|"task.update"|"ticket.transition"|"ticket.comment"`
- `Intent = { id, kind: IntentKind, payload: { [key: string]: unknown }, state: IntentState, proposedBy: { principal: Principal, via?: Via }, clientIntentId: string|null, decidedBy: string|null, decidedAt: string|null, result: { [key: string]: unknown }|null, error: string|null, createdAt, updatedAt }`
- `IntentState = "pending_approval"|"approved"|"running"|"done"|"failed"|"denied"`
- `Principal = { kind: "person"|"agent", id, login? }`
- `Via = { kind: "page"|"job"|"integration", id, version?: int }`
- `Job = { id, roomId, state: JobState, agent: string|null, instruction, input: unknown, resultSchema: unknown|null, progress: string|null, result: unknown, error: string|null, messageId: string|null, createdBy: { principal: { kind: "person"|"agent", id }, via?: Via }, createdAt, updatedAt, finishedAt: string|null }`
- `JobState = "queued"|"no_agent"|"running"|"needs_input"|"done"|"failed"|"cancelled"`
